# Teachers Pay Teachers
> Online marketplace for original educational resources, lesson plans, activities, and classroom materials for PreK–12 and beyond.

Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) helps educators discover, purchase, and share classroom-tested teaching resources across grade levels, subjects, and instructional formats. The site organizes materials by school level, grade, subject, and activity type, with additional support for sellers, school purchasing, and account management.

## Core Marketplace
- [Browse All Resources](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse): Explore the full marketplace of teaching resources across grades, subjects, and formats.
- [Elementary](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary): Find teaching resources designed for elementary classrooms and learners.
- [Middle School](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/middle-school): Browse classroom materials tailored to middle school grades and subjects.
- [High School](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/high-school): Discover instructional resources for high school courses and grade levels.
- [Adult Education](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/adult-education): Access resources intended for adult education and continuing learning settings.
- [Student Practice](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/student-practice): Browse materials focused on practice, review, and independent student work.

## Elementary Grades
- [Preschool](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/preschool): Browse early learning resources for preschool classrooms and activities.
- [Kindergarten](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/kindergarten): Find kindergarten lesson materials, printables, and classroom activities.
- [1st Grade](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/1st-grade): Explore teaching resources aligned to first grade instruction.
- [2nd Grade](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/2nd-grade): Discover worksheets, lessons, and activities for second grade learners.
- [3rd Grade](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/3rd-grade): Access third grade classroom resources across core subjects.
- [4th Grade](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/4th-grade): Browse fourth grade materials for instruction, review, and enrichment.
- [5th Grade](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/elementary/5th-grade): Find fifth grade resources for classroom and homework use.

## Practice & Independent Work
- [Student Practice](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/student-practice): Browse resources built for student review, reinforcement, and practice.
- [Independent Work Packet](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/student-practice/independent-work-packet): Find packet-based resources for self-paced or take-home work.
- [Browse All Resources](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse): Return to the full catalog for additional activity types and formats.

## Seller & Creator Resources
- [Sell on TPT](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Sell): Learn how educators can open a store and sell original resources.
- [Seller Blog](https://sellerblog.teacherspayteachers.com/): Read articles and tips for TPT sellers and teacher-authors.
- [TPT School Access](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/School-Access): Explore school-funded access to teacher-created resources.
- [Gift Card](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Gift-Card): Purchase digital gift cards for educators and classroom resource buying.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://help.teacherspayteachers.com/hc/en-us): Get support articles for buying, selling, and account questions.
- [Buyer FAQ](https://help.teacherspayteachers.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000032946-Buyers): Find help for purchases, downloads, and buyer account issues.
- [Seller FAQ](https://help.teacherspayteachers.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000032966-Sellers): Access support for store setup, product listings, and seller policies.
- [School Access Help](https://help.teacherspayteachers.com/hc/en-us/categories/4403654942733-TPT-School-Access): Learn about school purchasing workflows and School Access support.
- [Contact Support](https://help.teacherspayteachers.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Submit a support request to TPT customer service.

## Account & Policies
- [Login](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Login): Sign in to a TPT buyer or seller account.
- [Join](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Join): Create a new account to buy, download, or sell resources.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Terms-of-Service): Review the platform terms governing use of TPT.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Privacy-Policy): Read how TPT collects, uses, and protects personal information.
- [Copyright and Trademark Policy](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Copyright-and-Trademark-Policy): Understand intellectual property rules for marketplace content.
- [Security](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/security): Review TPT security practices and platform protections.
